import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 400000

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat


theorem imo_1977_p6
  (f : ℕ → ℕ)
  (h₀ : ∀ n, 0 < f n)
  (h₁ : ∀ n, 0 < n → f (f n) < f (n + 1)) :
  ∀ n, 0 < n → f n = n := by
  sorry

∀ n, 0 < n → f n = n := by
  -- Key lemma: m ≤ f m for all m > 0, by strong induction on the value v = f m.
  have C : ∀ v, ∀ m, 0 < m → f m = v → m ≤ v := by
    intro v
    induction v using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ v ih =>
      intro m hm hfm
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have hv : 0 < v := by have := h₀ m; omega
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
      have hk : 0 < k := by omega
      have hy : 0 < f k := h₀ k
      have hlt : f (f k) < v := by
        have := h₁ k hk
        omega
      rcases le_or_lt v (f k) with hvy | hyv
      · have := ih (f (f k)) hlt (f k) hy rfl
        omega
      · have := ih (f k) hyv k hk rfl
        omega
  have L : ∀ n, 0 < n → n ≤ f n := fun n hn => C (f n) n hn rfl
  -- Strict monotonicity: f n < f (n+1).
  have hs : ∀ n, 0 < n → f n < f (n + 1) := by
    intro n hn
    have h1 := h₁ n hn
    have h2 := L (f n) (h₀ n)
    omega
  -- Weak monotonicity on positive arguments.
  have mono : ∀ a, 0 < a → ∀ b, a ≤ b → f a ≤ f b := by
    intro a ha b hab
    induction b, hab using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact le_refl _
    | succ n hn ih => exact le_trans ih (le_of_lt (hs n (by omega)))
  intro n hn
  have h3 := L n hn
  have h4 : f n ≤ n := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have h5 := mono (n + 1) (by omega) (f n) (by omega)
    have h6 := h₁ n hn
    omega
  omega
